info.title: Iconive API
info.description:
Complete OpenAPI 3.0 documentation for the Iconive Backend.

## Authentication
Most protected endpoints require a JWT Bearer token.
1. Call `POST /api/auth/login` or `POST /api/auth/signUp`
2. Copy the returned `token`
3. Click **Authorize** in Swagger UI and enter: `Bearer <token>` (or just the token — Swagger UI adds Bearer automatically)

## Roles
- `user` — default customer role
- `admin` — administrative operations
- `isWholeSaler` — wholesaler flag on the user (used by wholesale flows)

Documentation is derived from the live Express routes and models and does not change API behavior.

bearerAuth.description: JWT access token. Obtain via POST /api/auth/login or POST /api/auth/signUp. Send as: `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

verified.description: If false, an activation email is sent. If true/omitted, account is created without requiring email activation flow.

UserUpdate.description: Updatable user profile fields. Password fields are not allowed.
